stijl: Square old-school internet meme template image, drawn in vintage pop-art comic style: bold black ink outlines, flat colours with Ben-Day halftone dots, slightly off-register print. Strict limited palette: ultramarine blue, sunny yellow, bubblegum pink, cream white, black. One character only, shown waist-up or as a big close-up, centered, with one very clear, exaggerated facial expression, like a classic reaction meme. Background: a single flat colour with a soft halftone sunburst, nothing else. The top 25% and bottom 25% of the image must be calm and empty background so big meme text can be placed there later; the face sits in the middle. Original character only, not resembling any existing meme, photo or superhero. Characters: CAPTAIN COASTER, a slightly chubby, overconfident male superhero in an ultramarine suit with a yellow cape, yellow eye mask and a plain round yellow disc on his chest, short dark brown side-parted hair; PINK PANIC, a sharp, unimpressed female superhero in a bubblegum pink suit with a pink eye mask and short black hair; DOCTOR FAKE, a clunky boxy retro robot with antenna, round eyes and a pink metal body. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no logos, no signature, no frame.
